why: A new exploiter for the tuner's panel, against the Greedy of ADR 0108, which reads a purchase against what its team is buying and now opens Brute + Warped instead of two Brutes. The panel was searched against the old Greedy and has gone stale against the new one: on content 95a78999 and the 200 benchmark seeds mirrored, mixture-mean beats it 0.748 in 10.1 rounds, kill-first 0.540, search-21 0.480, search-19 0.403, and search-23, the newest, 0.200. The exploit term reads the best of the panel, so it is reading one set while three of five have stopped being exploiters at all. This rung starts from mixture-mean, the one that still is, against Greedy alone, because Greedy is the player the exploit term measures the content against (ADR 0052); search-23 is the hold-out's check, so a set that only learned Greedy shows. 5 rounds of 12, seed 0. What would make it a rung: a set that beats mixture-mean's 0.748 against Greedy on seeds it never saw, without falling below it against search-23. Whatever it finds joins the panel rather than replacing a member (ADR 0052).
